blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two of the Philippines’ largest telecommunications companies are awaiting formal notice from the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) over a P100,000 daily penalty that the regulator said it was imposing on them and another player for “poor mobile broadband signals” in Metro Manila.
